# Release Notes Template

Use this template when manual notes are needed in addition to auto-generated GitHub release notes.

## Summary
- One to three bullets describing user-visible outcomes.

## Breaking changes
- `N/A` or explicit migration steps.

## Added
- Feature bullets.

## Changed
- Behavior updates and compatibility notes.

## Fixed
- Bug fixes with impact scope.

## Security
- Security-relevant updates and required operator action.

## Deprecations
- Deprecated contracts, planned removal version, and migration guidance.

## Upgrade notes
- Commands, config migrations, rollout order, and rollback hints.
